author: Huawei
description:
In Italy, an abandoned public building has evolved into a cultural hub powered by connectivity.

For more than a decade, Casa delle Arti (House of the Arts) has brought people together in Conversano. Following an innovative regeneration project, it has transformed into a multipurpose center where artists and communities come together through music, theater and literature.
 
Led by Italian cultural initiative La Tornanza and supported by #Huawei, Casa delle Arti has grown as a connected Digital Village while preserving its role at the heart of the Conversano community. Explore Casa delle Arti's story: https://bit.ly/4yFZfRe #TECHcares
title: Casa delle Arti: From Abandoned Building to Cultural Hub
